about: Cases on the project fixtures, run in CI on every platform. The expected answers come from the fixture source itself.

cases.title: The first overview of the mod answers with its event namespaces
cases.evidence: fixtures/event/workspace/events/synthetic_alpha_01.txt declares add_namespace = synthetic_alpha.

cases.title: The next free synthetic_alpha event id follows the highest one
cases.evidence: synthetic_alpha_01.txt and synthetic_alpha_02.txt define synthetic_alpha.1 to synthetic_alpha.80 with no gaps after 80.

cases.title: A scripted effect is found at its definition with its event caller
cases.evidence: synthetic_alpha_outer is defined at common/scripted_effects/synthetic_event_helpers.txt:2 and called at events/synthetic_alpha_01.txt:60.

cases.title: A repeated lookup answers from the warm index
cases.evidence: Same symbol as synthetic.source_lookup.helper-definition.

cases.title: An unknown symbol is an explicit not-found, not ok with nothing
cases.evidence: No file of the fixture or stand-in game mentions synthetic_no_such_symbol.

cases.title: The example call in the tool description works
cases.evidence: The tools/list description shows {"symbol":"my_scripted_effect"}; an agent copying it on a mod without that symbol must get a clear not-found, not an argument error.

cases.title: A documented effect in its scope is valid and fully checked
cases.evidence: The stand-in effects documentation lists add_political_power for COUNTRY.

cases.title: A country effect in state scope is a scope error
cases.evidence: The stand-in documentation supports add_political_power in COUNTRY only.

cases.title: A misspelled effect names the documented one
cases.evidence: add_politcal_power is one letter from add_political_power.

cases.title: A file with nothing unresolved is reported complete, not partial
cases.evidence: bench/fixtures/synthetic/common/scripted_effects/bench_regression_effects.txt holds one documented effect, country_event, inside a scripted effect.

expect.note: A partial check says inline which scope it could not check.

cases.title: A downstream trace reaches the event an option calls
cases.evidence: synthetic_alpha_01.txt:71 calls country_event = { id = synthetic_alpha.6 } from an option of an earlier event.

cases.title: An event fired only through a scripted effect has that effect as its caller
cases.evidence: bench_regress.1 is fired by bench_regress_fire_effect, which the decision bench_regress_decision runs (bench/fixtures/synthetic).

expect.note: The helper caller appears in the inline answer.

cases.title: An unknown event id is an explicit not-found
cases.evidence: synthetic_alpha events stop at synthetic_alpha.80.

cases.title: A scan of one file covers only that file's events
cases.evidence: events/bench_regressions.txt defines exactly one event, bench_regress.1.

expect.note: Findings come only from the selected file.

cases.title: The decision inventory lists the regression decision
cases.evidence: bench/fixtures/synthetic/common/decisions/bench_regression_decisions.txt defines bench_regress_decision.

expect.note: The inventory names the decisions inline.

cases.title: An unknown decision id is an explicit not-found
cases.evidence: No decision named synthetic_no_such_decision exists.

cases.title: A technology is explained
cases.evidence: fixtures/technology defines synthetic_tech_0001.

expect.note: The explanation names what the technology leads to.

cases.title: An unknown technology id is an explicit not-found
cases.evidence: The fixture has 1,040 technologies numbered synthetic_tech_0001 upward; synthetic_tech_9999 is not one.

cases.title: The acceptance focus tree is read
cases.evidence: fixtures/focus defines synthetic_acceptance_tree with 255 focuses.

cases.title: An unknown focus tree is an explicit not-found
cases.evidence: No tree named synthetic_no_such_tree exists.

cases.title: The fixture window is read
cases.evidence: fixtures/gui defines synthetic_gui_window.

cases.title: An unknown window is an explicit not-found with a small result
cases.evidence: No window named synthetic_no_such_window exists.

cases.title: A sweep honours the requested adapter and step count
cases.evidence: The request asks for decision_ai_will_do with 5 steps over variable.pressure.

cases.title: A scripted effect's consumers include the event that calls it
cases.evidence: events/synthetic_alpha_01.txt:60 calls synthetic_alpha_outer.

cases.title: The focus tree renders to a PNG
cases.evidence: fixtures/focus/workspace/common/national_focus/synthetic_acceptance.txt.

cases.title: An exact command name is the first hit
cases.evidence: The stand-in effects documentation has a section named add_political_power.

cases.title: A query for something that does not exist returns nothing
cases.evidence: No document mentions zzqx_imaginary_command.

cases.title: The log's mod error points at its source file
cases.evidence: tests/helpers/smoke-fixture.ts writes an error.log whose first line names events/synthetic_alpha_01.txt near line 14.

cases.title: A wrapped parser error is explained as an unexpected token at the inner message's line in the mod file
cases.evidence: tests/helpers/smoke-fixture.ts writes this line to error.log. The inner message names line 12; the outer "near line: 14" is the end of the read. events/synthetic_alpha_01.txt is a mod file.

arguments.line: [09:15:02][persistent.cpp:48]: Error: "Unexpected token: }, near line: 12" in file: "events/synthetic_alpha_01.txt" near line: 14

cases.title: The game's own syntax error in a mod file is the top problem of the mod's health
cases.evidence: tests/helpers/smoke-fixture.ts writes an error.log whose first line is a parser error in the mod's events/synthetic_alpha_01.txt; the game reporting that it cannot read a file outranks every other finding.

cases.title: A new localisation key previews as one appended line in the English file with the most keys, in that file's indent, and nothing is written
cases.evidence: fixtures/technology/workspace/localisation/english/synthetic_technology_l_english.yml holds the most English keys, starts with a BOM and l_english:, and indents its keys by nothing. bench_write_probe is defined nowhere. apply is false, so the call writes nothing.

cases.title: A compatibility check against a mod that is not registered is an explicit not-found, without running the engine
cases.evidence: No workspace named synthetic_no_such_mod exists; the check resolves the other mod before it reads any file. The engine-backed modes need the Rust engine, which CI does not build.

cases.title: A literal "undefined" event description is found
cases.evidence: bench/fixtures/synthetic/events/bench_regressions.txt: bench_regress.2 has desc = undefined, and no language defines a key named undefined. Moved from the ZIN corpus, which fixed its own case.

expect.note: The synthetic corpus merges every fixture workspace, which leaves other keys undefined too, so only the listing is checked.
